title: gauquelin_sector: thread starname through geometric branch (imeth 0/1)
description:
The public `Ephemeris::gauquelin_sector` dispatcher accepts `starname: Option<&str>` but for imeth 0/1 routes to `gauquelin_sector_geometric` which only takes `body: Body` — starname is silently dropped. The C `swe_gauquelin_sector` geometric branch calls `swe_fixstar(starname, ...)` instead of `swe_calc(ipl, ...)` when `do_fixstar` is true (swecl.c:6356-6362, docs/c-ref-gauquelin-riseset.md §9). The rise/set branch (imeth 2-5) already threads starname correctly to `rise_trans`.

Fix: accept `starname: Option<&str>` in `gauquelin_sector_geometric` and call `fixstar2` instead of `calc` when it's `Some(non_empty)`. Add golden cases with a fixed star for at least imeth 0 and one rise/set imeth.

Found by Codex review of swisseph-rs/89.">
execution_record: Straightforward — added starname:Option<&str> parameter to gauquelin_sector_geometric, dispatching to fixstar2 when non-empty. One surprise: initially placed swe_set_ephe_path at the top of gen_houses.c's main(), which changed the default ephemeris backend for Sunshine (I/i) ut_wrapper cases from Moshier-fallback to actual Swiss Ephemeris, silently altering ~5 existing golden rows. Fixed by setting the path only immediately before the star sub-block. Star rise/set cases (imeth=2) diverge by ~3.5e-6 from C due to the known fixstar-TOPOCTR gap in rise_trans (star positions aren't computed with the per-call topographic override); widened tolerance to 1e-5 for star rise/set cases only.
